question: Who is credited with creating the popular Raga Miya Ki Malhar ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tansen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Miyan Tansen,** a distinguished classical music composer, musician, and vocalist, is credited with creating the popular raga Miyan Ki Malhar during the 16th century.
 
• He held a prominent position in the court of the Mughal Emperor Akbar and was revered as the **"Sangeet Samrat" or the "Monarch of Indian Music".**
 
• Miyan Ki Malhar, a monsoon raga, is often employed to herald the arrival of the monsoon season and to invoke rainfall.
 
• The melodic patterns of this raga have the ability to emulate the rumbling thunder of clouds and the cascading torrents of rain.
 
• Malhar, an ancient raga in Indian classical music, is deeply associated with the onset of torrential rains and is renowned for its evocative portrayal of the monsoon season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

**Important Points__**

 
• **Amir Khusrau** was a prominent Indo-Persian Sufi singer, musician, poet, and scholar who thrived during the era of the Delhi Sultanate. Revered as an iconic figure in the cultural heritage of South Asia, he was renowned for his mysticism and spiritual devotion as a disciple of Nizamuddin Auliya of Delhi, India.
 
• **Meera, also known as Mirabai, **was a revered Hindu mystic poet and devotee of Lord Krishna during the 16th century. Venerated as Sant Meerabai, she remains a celebrated Bhakti saint, especially within the North Indian Hindu tradition.
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain,** an eminent figure in the realm of Indian classical music, is recognized as a tabla player, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor. He is the eldest son of the legendary tabla player Alla Rakha and is widely regarded as one of the greatest tabla players in history.
